checks: Exact request SHA, three inputs and gh command verified. Ten sorted control rows/hash recomputed from current bytes and frozen Git blobs; source/local review pins unchanged. Canonical parent changes are exactly the three reviewed files. Normal push/ls-remote/stop0 receipt agrees with frozen HEAD/tree; no reviewer network check.
scope: One Ubuntu24.04 job,10minutes: admitted source/controls, real emulator-package-only SDK setup (180s+10s kill bound,4minute step), then unchanged no-build host/control diagnostic. Other4jobs excluded. No system images/platforms, emulator launch, app build/packaging or Store operation.
reused_review: Previously accepted source/60-test/focused-actionlint evidence is reused at identical bytes, not repeated or relabelled hosted runtime. Source/UID/SDK/ownership/child retirement/upload/final strict audit/Gradle-stop guards remain covered by those unchanged pinned reviews.
coordinator_prerequisite: Root alone must freshly recheck active workflow, no live same-ref run, exact remote/ref/HEAD/tree and clean source, then dispatch exactly once. Existing cancel-in-progress must not supersede live work. Reviewer performs no external calls.

independent_audit.method: Read-only Git and standard-library hash/JSON/CSV binding assertions only; no project import, validator, test, build, SDK or process execution.

preserved.limit: No D03 cause/retirement repair, application/combined qualification, physical-device, Store or owner/legal credit.
